watch.summary: After getting scored on in Rocket League, the streamer hilariously schemes to report and ban his opponent out of pure salty frustration.

beats.what: The opponent scores a goal and the creator screams in rage.
The creator starts plotting to ban the opponent so he can never stream snipe again.
The opponent scores yet another goal mid-rant while the creator is complaining.
The creator insists he will report him to Epic Games to stop ruining his parade.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I've got to ban this guy on my account so he never knows when I'm streaming again.
watch.why: The creator's petty rant about banning his opponent is made even funnier by the comedic timing of getting scored on again mid-sentence.
